items.exampleEn: We opened a bottle of champagne at the wedding.
items.exampleZh: 我們在婚禮上開了一瓶香檳。

items.exampleEn: Grandma always cooks supper for us.
items.exampleZh: 奶奶總是煮晚飯給我們吃。

items.exampleEn: The fried potatoes at this restaurant are very good.
items.exampleZh: 這家餐廳的炸馬鈴薯很好吃。

items.exampleEn: I broke my favorite mug this morning.
items.exampleZh: 我今天早上把我最喜歡的馬克杯打破了。

items.exampleEn: This cereal is too sweet for me.
items.exampleZh: 這種穀片對我來說太甜了。

items.exampleEn: Would you like butter on your toast?
I'd like a ham sandwich, please.

items.sentenceEn: We had fried rice for supper.

items.audioEn: For breakfast, I usually have toast and a mug of hot tea.
items.audioZh: 早餐我通常吃吐司，配一馬克杯熱茶。
items.questionZh: 說話的人早餐通常吃什麼？

items.sentenceEn: This mug was a gift from my sister.
items.sentenceZh: 這個馬克杯是我姊姊送的禮物。

items.sentenceEn: Pass me the ham and the cheese, please.
items.sentenceZh: 請把火腿和起司遞給我。

items.stemEn: We won the game! Let's have a glass of ____.
items.stemZh: 我們贏了比賽！來喝一杯香檳吧。

items.stemEn: I need a clean ____ for my hot chocolate.
items.stemZh: 我需要一個乾淨的馬克杯來裝熱可可。

items.passageEn: On Sunday mornings, my family has a big breakfast. My mother makes fried eggs and ham, and my father makes toast. My little sister only eats cereal. Everyone drinks coffee or tea from their own mug. In the evening, we have a small supper because we eat so much in the morning.
items.passageZh: 每個星期天早上，我們家都會吃一頓豐盛的早餐。媽媽做煎蛋和火腿，爸爸烤吐司。我妹妹只吃穀片。每個人都用自己的馬克杯喝咖啡或茶。晚上我們的晚飯吃得很少，因為早上吃太多了。

questions.questionZh: 他們晚上為什麼吃得很少？

items.promptZh: 我們今晚的晚飯吃什麼？
referenceEn: What are we having for supper tonight?
What will we eat for supper tonight?
rubricZh: 「吃」可寫例如 have、eat；問句用 What 開頭

items.instructionZh: 用 fried 造一個句子，說說你喜歡或不喜歡的一種油炸食物。
rubricZh: fried 常放在食物前（例如 fried chicken），也可放在 be 動詞後（例如 The chicken was fried.）
說喜不喜歡可寫例如 I love…、I don't like…
